title: Petra and the Winter
author: Zephyrine Nakamura
blurb: Casper Sandoval, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, has spent seven years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
